[IRET.3.2] A `String`/`Bytes` fact-slot value is interned
**counted** at fact commit ([IRET.1.4]): the intern returns the
canonical pointer, stable **while at least one live fact holds
the value** and freed when the last holder retracts. Pinned
structural strings are stable for the engine's lifetime. Two
**stored** equal strings share a pointer (Rete comparisons use
`==`); eval-level string equality is by **content**, so a
transient (arena, un-interned) computed operand still compares
equal to a byte-equal stored value.
